intro.passion: I automate business processes and build web applications, and I keep learning through my work and my studies at 42.

about.heading: About Me
about.bio_suffix: , a ServiceNow application developer and fullstack developer based in Antananarivo. I work at Pulse and I'm studying at 42 Antananarivo, which keeps me learning through both real projects and school ones.

education.title: Education
education.hei_desc: Specialized in Software Ecosystems: software development, information systems design and software engineering.
education.42_desc: Peer-to-peer learning with no teachers, built around intensive projects, autonomy and curiosity.

passions.title: What Drives Me
passions.subtitle: Turning repetitive business tasks into reliable, automated workflows.
passions.coding_desc: Writing modular code that other developers can read and maintain.
passions.solving_desc: Removing manual steps so users can focus on their actual work.
passions.learning_desc: Picking up new tools through work, side projects and the 42 curriculum.

experience.heading: Professional Experience
experience.subtitle: ServiceNow development, front-end work on a large Angular application, and a fullstack internship.

servicenow.desc: I build and evolve business applications on the ServiceNow platform. The goal is to automate internal processes so users spend less time on manual steps.
servicenow.h1: Developing and evolving business solutions on the ServiceNow platform.
servicenow.h2: Automating business processes with Flow Designer, Business Rules and reusable Script Includes.
servicenow.h3: Writing Client Scripts and configuring Service Catalog items to improve the end-user experience.
servicenow.h4: Building REST integrations and testing changes on a development instance before they are promoted.

frontend.desc: I worked on an Angular 19 web application used to manage several Malagasy companies, with a focus on a modular codebase and a smooth user experience.
frontend.h1: Developed and optimized the Angular 19 application: modular architecture and reusable components.
frontend.h2: Improved performance and applied UX best practices across the interface.
frontend.h3: Migrated existing Angular 16 applications to version 19.

fullstack.desc: An internship that covered the whole development cycle, from design to production, on a GraphQL API and its web interface.
fullstack.h1: Designed a GraphQL API with NestJS, using a test-driven development (TDD) approach.
fullstack.h2: Built a fast web interface with Next.js.
fullstack.h3: Worked on every stage of the cycle: design, development and release to production.

42.desc: Peer-to-peer curriculum with no teachers. I learned programming fundamentals through intensive projects, in a collaborative environment that rewards autonomy and curiosity.
42.h1: Solid programming foundations built through intensive projects, mostly in C and C++.
42.h2: Rigorous algorithmic thinking and problem solving: push_swap, Minishell, Cub3D, ft_irc, Inception.
42.h3: Collaborative learning that develops autonomy and curiosity.

hei.degree: Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Software Ecosystems
hei.desc: Three-year degree specialized in Software Ecosystems, covering software development, information systems design and software engineering.
hei.h1: Hands-on projects in software development, information systems design and software engineering.
hei.h2: Deeper knowledge of cloud, cybersecurity, artificial intelligence and software engineering.
hei.h3: Training in teamwork, project management and entrepreneurship.

skills.heading: Technical Capabilities
skills.subtitle: What I work with day to day.

servicenow.title: ServiceNow & Enterprise Platform
servicenow.desc: Business process automation and custom workflow development on the ServiceNow platform.
servicenow.c1_desc: Automated workflows, event triggers and approvals.
servicenow.c2_desc: Business Rules, Script Includes, Client Scripts and UI Policies.
servicenow.c3_desc: Incidents, changes, service requests and catalog items.
servicenow.c4_desc: Data exchange with external systems through REST/JSON APIs.

fullstack.title: Web Development & APIs
fullstack.desc: Web applications from the interface to the API, built with maintainable architecture.
fullstack.c1_desc: Angular 19, Next.js and TypeScript, including an Angular 16 to 19 migration.
fullstack.c2_desc: NestJS, Node.js, Express and Spring Boot, with REST and GraphQL APIs.
fullstack.c3_desc: Test-driven development, data validation and SOLID principles.

systems.title: Systems, Concurrency & Algorithms
systems.desc: Low-level programming and algorithms, learned at 42.
systems.c1_desc: Manual memory management, file descriptors, POSIX signals and Makefiles.
systems.c2_desc: Thread synchronization, mutexes and deadlock prevention.
systems.c3_desc: TCP servers and I/O multiplexing with poll and select.

data_devops.title: Databases, DevOps & Tooling
data_devops.desc: Data storage, containers and everyday team tooling.
data_devops.c1_desc: Relational modeling with PostgreSQL and document data with MongoDB.
data_devops.c2_desc: Dockerfiles and multi-container setups with Docker Compose, on Linux.
data_devops.c3_desc: Git, GitHub, GitLab, GitHub Actions CI/CD and Trello for task tracking.

projects.heading: Featured Projects
projects.subtitle: A selection of projects showing what I build outside of work.
projects.portfolio_desc: My portfolio, built with React and TypeScript to showcase my projects and experience.
projects.valentin_desc: A romantic and interactive digital invitation crafted for a Valentine's Day proposal.
projects.solong_desc: A 2D tile-based game navigating a character, collecting items, and finding the exit with clean event handling.
projects.cub3d_desc: A 3D maze exploration game built from scratch using raycasting and MinilibX, exploring computer graphics fundamentals.
projects.coucou_desc: Real-time chat API powering messaging, authentication, and conversations, built with NestJS for modularity.

projects_42.heading: 42 Common Core
projects_42.subtitle: Key projects from the common core, covering systems programming, networks, algorithms, and DevOps.
projects_42.libft_desc: First standard C library rewrite from scratch to understand libc internals.
projects_42.get_next_line_desc: Function reading a line from a file descriptor, handling multiple descriptors and static memory.
projects_42.ft_printf_desc: Custom libc printf implementation supporting standard format specifiers.
projects_42.born2beroot_desc: Configured a hardened Debian virtual machine with strict password rules, SSH, UFW, sudo and monitoring.
projects_42.push_swap_desc: Highly optimized sorting algorithm using two stacks and limited instruction set.
projects_42.minitalk_desc: Client-server communication application using UNIX signals (SIGUSR1/SIGUSR2) for binary data transfer.
projects_42.solong_desc: 2D game focusing on window management, keyboard/mouse event handling and MiniLibX rendering.
projects_42.minishell_desc: Fully functional shell interpreter mimicking bash with environment variables, paths, pipes, and redirects.
projects_42.philosophers_desc: Dining philosophers implementation focusing on thread synchronization, mutexes, and deadlock prevention.
projects_42.cub3d_desc: 3D graphics game engine inspired by Wolfenstein 3D, implementing raycasting principles.
projects_42.netpractice_desc: Networking exercises configuring IP addressing, subnetting, and routing tables.
projects_42.cpp_00_04_desc: C++ modules learning object-oriented programming concepts in C++98.
projects_42.inception_desc: DevOps project configuring a secure multi-container architecture with Nginx, WordPress and MariaDB via Docker.
projects_42.ft_irc_desc: Complete IRC server in C++98 handling TCP sockets, select()/poll() multiplexing, and IRC protocol.
projects_42.cpp_05_09_desc: Advanced C++ modules covering templates, STL containers, iterators, casts and exception handling.
